question: With what offerings and in what manner should worship be performed afterward?
premises: Fragrance, flowers, and similar items are to be used.
Food offerings and related items are also to be used.
The worship must follow the proper order.
inference: Therefore, one should worship afterward in order with fragrance, flowers, food offerings, and other items.
uncertainties: naivodyāntaiḥ: internal sandhi resolution uncertain, token kept whole
plain_english: Afterwards, one should worship in order with fragrances, flowers, food offerings, and other items.
